static_traits.name: Patrick Knox
static_traits.social_status: 有少数朋友可交谈,但尚not yet向其分享财务与情绪困境;Interpersonal relationships因自我隔离而紧张
static_traits.medical_history: 过去有经济困难但No major physical illness;not yet接受过类似心理治疗
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,能具体描述感受与经历;合作度较高,Neutral attitude;常出现绝对化与负性自我陈述(如'永远''失败')

basic_info.main_problem: 因财务困难(与居住在波士顿郊区相关)长期感到despair与without望,担忧自己会被困在当地,without法改善经济状况;压力持续多年并日常化,看到他人财务稳定时加剧.
basic_info.core_demands: 持续的despair与without望感影响身心与生活质量,希望通过咨询获得支持,Learning以更积极,现实的方式看待当前处境并改善思维模式.
growth_experiences: 几年前遭遇财务挫折,起初仍抱有改善希望,但随后进展not理想,逐步发展为持续性的高压力与负面认知.此后几乎每天担心被困在波士顿郊区,without法改善财务状况;看到周围人实现财务稳定时自责与失落加重.虽尝试过预算与寻找额外Work,但主观的without望感仍not yet缓解.

core_beliefs: 我被困住,without法改善自己的处境
我在经济上是失败者,not yet来也not会好转

special_situations.event: Finding little progress when checking the bank account
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我看not到明显的财务进步,就意味着我not可能摆脱困境
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries strict budgeting and finding extra work to prove oneself can change the status quo

special_situations.event: 看到周围的人实现财务稳定或表现Good
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not如他人稳定,就说明I am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids socializing,减少与朋友联系以避免被比较与评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not如他们,I am a failure

special_situations.event: Thinking of living in a Boston suburb with financial strain
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我现在很贫穷,就会永远被困在这里,without法改变
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 以非黑即白方式评估not yet来,反复担忧以试图掌控not确定性

special_situations.event: Repeatedly thinking about financial problems before falling asleep at night
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我without法立即解决财务难题,就意味着no hope
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Uses negative self-talk to pressure oneself into change

core_conflict.wish: Longs to escape financial difficulty, regain control and hope, and be understood and supported by others
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被视为失败者,暴露脆弱后遭到羞耻与评判;害怕永远被困住,without法改变命运
defense_goal: Avoids shame and negative evaluation by keeping distance from others
Lowers expectations through preemptive pessimism and catastrophizing to avoid disappointment again

object_relations.object_representation: 他人/社会是评判性的旁观者,会看not起我

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked whether they have sought support from friends, or invited in counseling to share personal financial and emotional difficulties
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 他人会看not起我,觉得我失败;暴露真实状况会带来羞耻与拒绝(移情:Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use委婉与含混的表达,避免细节,强调'这太个人,很尴尬',语气轻缓,绕开核心问题,转向泛泛的描述.

manifestations: 反复担忧'被困在波士顿郊区''永远出not去'
Experiences financial limitations as a loss of choices and possibilities
Sense of hope for life declines; hard to see the positive side
outcomes: Daily rhythm is disrupted (sleep and exercise are affected)

contact_model.definition: 个体克制想对其他人或物做出的行为冲动,或放弃向外寻求do not人为其做某事,转而对自己做(将能量由外Turning against the self).
manifestations: 明知有朋友可谈却not分享困境
Presses the impulse to seek help back into oneself, turns into self-isolation and bearing it alone

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Overly cautious about sharing personal problems, worried about triggering others' negative evaluations

exception_events.target_problem: 在面对财务压力或比较他人稳定时,来访者通常会灾难化思考,认为自己永远without法改善,从而陷入despair并自我隔离.
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在某个'好的一天',来访者能够想到'也许事情have not我想得那么糟;我曾经挺过难关',从而获得更为平衡的视角与些许希望感.
exception_events.reason: Cue: that day she was able to recall and acknowledge past resilience and successful coping experiences, so a more balanced cognitive deviation point appeared in the moment.

positive_force: Occasionally able to produce a more balanced perspective and recall one's own resilience
Willing to try changing thinking styles and participating in counseling
Proactively takes practical measures (budgeting, looking for extra work)
Having a few reliable friends as resources
negative_force: 灾难化,非黑即白,过度概括,个人化,预测not yet来等认知偏差强
羞耻感与'失败者'自我标签导致Social avoidance
长期压力致Sleep disturbed,Decline in work performance与日常节律打乱
对not确定性的强烈Anxiety与担忧,感到缺乏控制感

antecedent: When seeing those around financially stable
When thinking about sharing his difficulties with friends, feels embarrassment and shame
target_behavior.core_reason: 担心被评判与羞耻,内化'I am a failure'的负性自我图式
target_behavior.function: Escaping being judged and negative emotional experiences
target_behavior.consequence: 与朋友和家人Relationship tension,Weakened support system,Loneliness感加重

target_behavior.behavior: Catastrophic thinking and repeated worry about finances
antecedent: When thinking of living in a Boston suburb with financial strain
target_behavior.core_reason: Excessive prediction of negative outcomes and black-and-white thinking; loss of sense of control triggered by past financial setbacks
target_behavior.function: 试图通过持续担忧获得对not确定性的主观控制与'心理准备'(not适应的Self-protection)
target_behavior.consequence: 情绪despair化,Sleep disturbed,注意力与Decline in work performance,进一步Reinforcement负性循环
